purpose: Prospectively expand the safe public-optimizer candidate pool before round-3 decision so the selector can encounter multiple strategy classes without selecting any specific public family in advance.

candidates.acceptance: After selector seal, bind a not-yet-audited public self-improvement/meta-optimization family before adaptation.

After selector seal, bind a not-yet-audited public optimizer whose primary mechanism is critique/feedback-guided search; if no qualifying distinct family is found from primary sources, terminate with a precise source-search blocker rather than relabeling an already-audited family.

After selector seal, bind a not-yet-audited public optimizer whose primary mechanism uses a population/archive/evolutionary search abstraction; if none qualifies, terminate with a precise source-search blocker.

After selector seal, bind a not-yet-audited public optimizer whose primary mechanism changes optimizer/search behavior from feedback or meta-level evaluation; if none qualifies, terminate with a precise source-search blocker.

immutability: Candidate IDs, strategy classes and priorities are frozen for these frontier items before any round-3 decision or family-specific semantic read.
